documentaryEvidence.scope: Public documentary evidence for La Guaira, Catia La Mar, Caraballeda, Playa Grande and nearby coastal communities after the June 24, 2026 earthquakes.
interpretationPolicy: Publication time is not automatically treated as the event time.
A place-specific witness report may conflict with a regional deployment claim without either being globally false.
Lack of reporting or imagery is never treated as proof that assistance was absent.
Documentary reports remain separate from aerial-image observations and official EMS damage data.

claims: On June 25, firefighters were reported as overwhelmed and heavy-machinery availability for rubble removal was limited.
Residents reported that they did not know where shelters for displaced people were operating.
Families in La Llanada requested water, food and other basic supplies.
claimsEs: El 25 de junio se reportó que los bomberos estaban desbordados y que había poca maquinaria pesada disponible para retirar escombros.
Residentes dijeron no saber dónde funcionaban los refugios para personas desplazadas.
Familias de La Llanada solicitaron agua, alimentos y otros suministros básicos.
sources.timePrecision: publication-day field report; individual observations lack exact times
sources.limitations: Some statements are attributed to residents or other reporting and are not a comprehensive inventory of the state response.

claims: EFE observed a large contingent of trucks bearing Chinese flags arrive in Catia La Mar with aid; private trucks and cars also delivered supplies.
A terminal was being used to distribute food and basic products.
Hundreds of people were sleeping on mattresses, sheets, chairs, in tents and improvised camps on asphalt, planters, plazas and sports courts.
claimsEs: EFE observó la llegada a Catia La Mar de un gran contingente de camiones con banderas chinas y ayuda; también llegaron suministros en camiones y vehículos privados.
Una terminal se utilizaba para distribuir alimentos y productos básicos.
Cientos de personas dormían en colchones, sábanas, sillas, carpas y campamentos improvisados sobre asfalto, jardineras, plazas y canchas.
sources.timePrecision: observed by publication date; no exact arrival time for the truck contingent
sources.limitations: The terminal is not named in the article and the report cannot establish conditions across every Catia La Mar sector.

claims: WFP reported beginning emergency food distribution in La Guaira in the days after the earthquakes.
WFP reported beginning installation of temporary food-distribution centers in La Guaira.
Response teams were deployed to affected areas and thousands of people were reported sleeping in evacuation shelters.
claimsEs: El PMA informó que comenzó a distribuir alimentos de emergencia en La Guaira durante los días posteriores a los terremotos.
El PMA informó que comenzó a instalar centros temporales de distribución de alimentos en La Guaira.
Se desplegaron equipos de respuesta en las zonas afectadas y se reportó que miles de personas dormían en refugios de evacuación.
sources.timePrecision: agency update published June 26; wording does not give exact opening times or site coordinates
sources.limitations: State-level report, not a site-by-site operating log.

claims: Maiquetía airport was enabled for receiving humanitarian assistance, cargo and people, while its coordination protocol was still pending.
The Caracas-La Guaira highway was open but congested, creating access delays.
Access to La Guaira was restricted and required prior registration to facilitate rescue and humanitarian operations.
claimsEs: El aeropuerto de Maiquetía fue habilitado para recibir asistencia humanitaria, carga y personas, mientras su protocolo de coordinación seguía pendiente.
La autopista Caracas-La Guaira estaba abierta pero congestionada, lo que generaba demoras de acceso.
El acceso a La Guaira estaba restringido y requería registro previo para facilitar las operaciones de rescate y asistencia humanitaria.
sources.limitations: Operational information was described as rapidly changing.

claims: At the reported Playa Grande collapse site, relatives described assistance from civilians, small firefighter and civil-protection teams, and international rescuers but no large machinery at that location.
A linked EFE update dated June 28 described a broader increase in heavy-machinery deployment for rubble removal.
claimsEs: En el sitio de colapso reportado en Playa Grande, familiares describieron ayuda de civiles, pequeños equipos de bomberos y protección civil, y rescatistas internacionales, pero no maquinaria grande en ese lugar.
Una actualización relacionada de EFE del 28 de junio describió un aumento más amplio del despliegue de maquinaria pesada para retirar escombros.
sources.timePrecision: site account four days after the earthquakes; broader deployment statement dated June 28
sources.limitations: The lack of large machinery is site-specific and cannot be generalized to all of La Guaira.

claims: UNDP estimated approximately 1.2 million tonnes of debris in the most affected parts of La Guaira.
Catia La Mar, Caraballeda and Urimare were identified as areas with the greatest estimated debris volumes and priorities for debris management.
claimsEs: El PNUD estimó aproximadamente 1,2 millones de toneladas de escombros en las zonas más afectadas de La Guaira.
Catia La Mar, Caraballeda y Urimare fueron identificadas como las áreas con mayor volumen estimado de escombros y como prioridades para su gestión.
sources.limitations: The estimate combines satellite imagery, AI damage assessment and engineering knowledge; it is planning evidence, not a machinery-deployment log.

claims: Three multiservice shelters were enabled in La Guaira: Polideportivo Vargas, Estadio César Nieves in Catia La Mar and provisional Estadio Playa Grande.
The June 26 government decision reserved Maiquetía airport for response-related cargo; by July 2 it had received government-to-government and UN humanitarian cargo.
claimsEs: Se habilitaron tres refugios multiservicio en La Guaira: Polideportivo Vargas, Estadio César Nieves en Catia La Mar y el refugio provisional Estadio Playa Grande.
La decisión gubernamental del 26 de junio reservó el aeropuerto de Maiquetía para carga vinculada con la respuesta; para el 2 de julio ya había recibido carga humanitaria bilateral y de la ONU.
sources.timePrecision: status as of July 2; shelter opening times are not specified
sources.limitations: Confirms operation by July 2 but not the exact opening time of each shelter.

claims: Thirteen of 25 reported transitional camps were in La Guaira.
Polideportivo Vargas, Estadio César Nieves and provisional Estadio Playa Grande remained active as multiservice shelters.
Maiquetía airport and the Port of La Guaira were restricted to humanitarian cargo under reported operating arrangements.
Access on the Caracas-La Guaira highway remained regulated for humanitarian movements.
claimsEs: Trece de los 25 campamentos transitorios reportados estaban en La Guaira.
Polideportivo Vargas, Estadio César Nieves y el refugio provisional Estadio Playa Grande seguían activos como refugios multiservicio.
El aeropuerto de Maiquetía y el Puerto de La Guaira estaban restringidos a carga humanitaria bajo los arreglos operativos reportados.
El acceso por la autopista Caracas-La Guaira seguía regulado para los movimientos humanitarios.
sources.limitations: Does not provide exact camp coordinates or opening dates for all 13 La Guaira sites.

conflictsAndBounds.finding: Regional reporting indicates machinery was mobilizing by June 25-26 and a broader increase by June 28, while a June 29 Playa Grande site report still described no large machinery at that specific collapse.
conflictsAndBounds.findingEs: Los reportes regionales indican que la maquinaria comenzó a movilizarse entre el 25 y el 26 de junio y que hubo un aumento más amplio para el 28; sin embargo, un reporte del 29 de junio todavía describía la ausencia de maquinaria grande en un colapso específico de Playa Grande.
conflictsAndBounds.interpretation: The evidence supports uneven deployment and site-level gaps, not a single statewide arrival time.
conflictsAndBounds.interpretationEs: La evidencia respalda un despliegue desigual y vacíos a nivel de sitio, no una única hora de llegada para todo el estado.

conflictsAndBounds.finding: Residents reported not knowing shelter locations on June 25; people were observed sleeping outdoors in Catia La Mar on June 26; named multiservice shelters are confirmed active by July 2.
conflictsAndBounds.findingEs: Residentes dijeron no conocer la ubicación de refugios el 25 de junio; el 26 se observó a personas durmiendo al aire libre en Catia La Mar; para el 2 de julio se confirma que funcionaban refugios multiservicio con nombre.
conflictsAndBounds.interpretation: The evidence bounds a transition from unclear or insufficient shelter access to confirmed named facilities, but does not establish exact opening times.
conflictsAndBounds.interpretationEs: La evidencia acota una transición desde un acceso incierto o insuficiente hacia instalaciones confirmadas, pero no establece sus horas exactas de apertura.

conflictsAndBounds.finding: Aid trucks and a terminal distribution point were observed in Catia La Mar by June 26, while access restrictions and congestion could delay or unevenly distribute assistance.
conflictsAndBounds.findingEs: Para el 26 de junio se observaron camiones de ayuda y un punto de distribución en una terminal de Catia La Mar, mientras las restricciones de acceso y la congestión podían demorar o distribuir de forma desigual la asistencia.
conflictsAndBounds.interpretation: Arrival in Catia La Mar does not establish delivery to every affected neighborhood.
conflictsAndBounds.interpretationEs: La llegada a Catia La Mar no demuestra que la ayuda alcanzara todos los sectores afectados.

method.arrivalRule: Dates are earliest visible bounds in available acquisitions, not actual arrival times.
method.absenceRule: Not observed does not mean did not occur.

guardrails: No model or detector observation is an official EMS fact.
No negative screen is evidence that help or an asset was absent.
First-visible acquisition time is not actual arrival time.
Pre-existing industrial assets and ordinary activity are major confounders.
Native pixels and source metadata require review before publication.
Super-resolution images are visualization-only and may introduce artifacts.
